description.content: Api is responsible for the comprehensive management of fields associated with data objects within a workflow. This includes functionality for retrieving available and existing fields, creating new fields, updating field properties, deleting fields, and reordering fields within a data object. Additionally, the controller enables the removal of a field from multiple data objects.
